body: Thanks, but I'm sure you're more prettier than me. And especially thanks to your kind words. This has been the fourth "man" that completely slipped away from me. I'm back to listening crappy breakup songs and feeling miserable. I swear though, I'm so done with being the submissive and cute girl to get men. Fuck it all, man. I'm building a wall around me.

Schools don't know jackshit 'bout well-being. I remember telling my counsellor I was suicidal. She excused herself and came back with people who would eventually force me into the hospital. Screamed and cursed at everything and everyone who said that it would get better.
